distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) reported Yunnan (Xishuangbanna) and an unspecified province in northeastern China. Lin & Smith (2022) listed China without provincial precision and reported a new Taiwan record. No northeastern province is inferred.

host_note: Lin & Smith (2022) reported the species-level hosts Castanopsis cuspidata and Quercus myrsinaefolia. Smith et al. (2020) mentioned Castanopsis and Quercus at genus level, not these specific host identities; no species-level attribution is transferred.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cyclorhipidion japonicum (Nobuchi, 1981).
